title: Kubernetes Rightsizing — Deployment
description: Diagnostyka zasobów deploymentu: CPU, RAM, requests/limits, CFS throttling, restarty i percentyle. Pod → ReplicaSet → Deployment z kube-state-metrics.

list.name: container
list.label: Kontener

query.query: query_result(count by (container) ((max by (cluster, namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_info{cluster=~"${cluster:raw}", namespace="$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"})) * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left (deployment) (max by (cluster, namespace, pod, deployment) ((max by (cluster, namespace, pod, replicaset) (label_replace(kube_pod_owner{cluster=~"${cluster:raw}", namespace="$namespace", owner_kind="ReplicaSet", owner_is_controller="true"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)")) * on (cluster, namespace, replicaset) group_left (deployment) max by (cluster, namespace, replicaset, deployment) (label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{cluster=~"${cluster:raw}", namespace="$namespace", owner_kind="Deployment", owner_is_controller="true", owner_name="$deployment"}, "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)")))))))

list.definition: query_result(count by (container) ((max by (cluster, namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_info{cluster=~"${cluster:raw}", namespace="$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"})) * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left (deployment) (max by (cluster, namespace, pod, deployment) ((max by (cluster, namespace, pod, replicaset) (label_replace(kube_pod_owner{cluster=~"${cluster:raw}", namespace="$namespace", owner_kind="ReplicaSet", owner_is_controller="true"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)")) * on (cluster, namespace, replicaset) group_left (deployment) max by (cluster, namespace, replicaset, deployment) (label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{cluster=~"${cluster:raw}", namespace="$namespace", owner_kind="Deployment", owner_is_controller="true", owner_name="$deployment"}, "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)")))))))
